doctrine: Trauma Theorem — Scar-Weight Propagation Matrix. Maps real-world entities to governance breaches and signature scars. When an entity is mentioned, agents MUST query this registry BEFORE responding.

schema_contract.description: Six mandatory fields per entity. No entity is valid without all six.

entity.description: Canonical name — the single authoritative label for this entity

aliases.description: All name variants for case-insensitive matching. Must include the canonical entity name in lowercase.

w_scar.description: Thermodynamic cost score. Assigned by F13 Sovereign. 0.0=neutral, 1.0=max cost.

archetype.description: Pattern class. Must match a registered archetype.

governance_breaches.description: Which constitutional floors this entity breaches. Empty array = no breaches (e.g. counter-power entities).

response_modifier.description: Injection text prepended to agent system context when entity is detected. Format: [CONTEXTUAL WEIGHT: Entity='X'. W_scar=N. ...]

injection_protocol.listen: Scan input for anchor entities below (case-insensitive alias match)
injection_protocol.metabolize: Query this registry for W_scar + governance_breaches + archetype
injection_protocol.inject: Prepend response_modifier to agent system context. NOT visible to user.
